name: September
summary: The connoisseur month: school back everywhere, every park still running its summer-lite calendar, and the entire Halloween season opening at the end of the month.

verdict.short: September at these parks: one of the year's best windows. The connoisseur month: school back everywhere, every park still running its summer-lite calendar, and the entire Halloween season opening at the end of the month..

cost.note: Ticket prices move by date at every park on this site; the level describes the month's overall shape rather than any single day.

planningNotes.heading: The month in one decision
body: The September weekday is this site's single best product: summer operation, school-year crowds, and weather that has stopped trying to kill you at the Texas parks.

planningNotes.heading: The detail that matters
body: The Halloween events open across the last ten days of the month and the weekends transform — the same park is two different products across one September Saturday.

freshness.sourceNote: Crowd and cost shapes describe multi-year patterns across the ten parks rather than a forecast for any single year. Weather figures are climate normals for each region and do not decay; the Texas figures blend the DFW and San Antonio areas, and the Southern California figures blend the coastal and inland valleys.
